value.zh: The ATI Tool Stand Small, or TSS, is compatible with a range of ATI small Tool Changers – models QC-001 through QC-21. The stand is designed for maximum flexibility to fit most customers’ applications. The modular system allows you to essentially “build your own” tool storage system based on the number of tools, positioning, and mounting arrangements desired. The TSS system provides a unique option to either use tooling interface plates or empty air ports on the tool changer as attachment points for your tooling.

value.zh: The ATI Medium Tool Stand System, or TSM, is compatible with the medium range of Tool Changers. TSM Pin & Bushing supports QC-60 through QC-110. TSM V-Block supports QC-40 through QC-110. These systems are designed for maximum flexibility to fit most customer applications. The modular system allows you to build your own tool storage rack based on the number of tools, positioning, orientation, and mounting arrangements required. The TSM mounting options provide unique options to utilize a complete arrangement of modules, or use only the tooling-interface Pin and Bushing Modules and mount them on your own fixture.

The modular system allows you to build your own tool storage rack based on the number of tools, positioning, orientation, and mounting arrangements required. value.zh: The ATI Large Tool Stand System, or TSL, is compatible with ATI Tool Changer models QC-150 and larger. The system is designed for durability, longevity, and maximum flexibility to fit most customer applications. The configurable system allows you to specify tool height, offset, shielding, and sensing. To save space, the TSL can even store two tools on the same post. ATI TSLs are currently in use in major automotive plants around the world.

integration.zh: 六维传感器用于机器人接触力控制与测试，称重和单轴产品面向测量设备及工业检测，风洞天平和平台面向专用试验。采集模块承担激励、信号调理及通信输出，因此部分供电、采样和接口参数属于模块而非裸传感器。
integration.en: Six-axis sensors serve robotic contact control and testing; load cells address industrial measurement, while wind-tunnel balances and platforms serve specialized experiments. Acquisition modules provide excitation, conditioning and communications, so some electrical specifications belong to the electronics rather than the bare transducer.

verification.zh: 判断：目录宽度有助于覆盖不同尺寸和量程，但产品数量不能直接代表交付规模。官网产能、融资及客户合作信息应与收入、订单和实际出货分开阅读。
verification.en: Assessment: catalog breadth supports different sizes and ranges, but model count is not delivery volume. Published capacity, financing and partnerships should be distinguished from revenue, orders and shipments.

overview.zh: 六维力传感器配套信号采集模块；RS422、RS485、CAN 为三个独立型号，不是一个模块同时包含三种输出。
overview.en: Signal acquisition module for six-axis force sensors; RS422, RS485 and CAN correspond to three separate models, not three simultaneous outputs on one module.

applications.zh: 公开场景涉及机器人本体、系统集成、计量测试与科研机构。选择时需核对轴向量程、联合载荷、安装刚度、温漂和标定矩阵。
applications.en: Public applications include robot OEMs, integrators, metrology and research. Selection requires checking per-axis ranges, combined loading, mounting stiffness, thermal drift and calibration matrices.

type.en: Instrument for contact and mechanical sensing

integration.zh: Modulus 提供可更换镜头及不同探头几何；Mobile、Shock Protected 和 Max 分别面向便携测量、现场保护及更高分辨率需求；Mini 面向触觉集成。不同光学配置的视场和精度不能混用。
integration.en: Modulus uses interchangeable optics and probe geometries. Mobile, Shock Protected and Max address portable inspection, field protection and higher-resolution measurement; Mini targets tactile integration. Field of view and accuracy are optical-configuration specific.

verification.zh: 判断：直接取得表面三维几何有助于定量检测；它不自动等同于标定后的三轴力反馈。商业评估需区分计量仪器收入和机器人嵌入式传感业务。
verification.en: Assessment: surface reconstruction supports quantitative inspection but is not automatically calibrated three-axis force feedback. Commercial assessment should distinguish metrology instruments from embedded robotics sensing.

overview.zh: GelSight Mini 是接触与力学测量器件。公开规格包括相机分辨率: 8MP；Measured Temperature Delta[°C]: 22.7 °C；Camera Frames Per Second: 25；Cartridge Replacement: Easily user replaceable cartridge that maintains position. Replacement does not require any tools/hardware.。
overview.en: GelSight Mini is an instrument for contact and mechanical sensing. Published specifications include Camera Resolution: 8MP; Measured Temperature Delta[°C]: 22.7 °C; Camera Frames Per Second: 25; Cartridge Replacement: Easily user replaceable cartridge that maintains position. Replacement does not require any tools/hardware..

overview.zh: 通过接触反馈获得物体表面或接触状态信息。测量区域、分辨率、表面材料和校准条件共同限定结果，不宜将空间精度等同于力量程。
overview.en: Uses contact feedback to measure surfaces or contact state. Measurement area, resolution, surface material and calibration conditions jointly bound the result; spatial accuracy is not a force range.

applications.zh: 客户场景包括制造质量、航空维修、汽车和机器人研发。接触可达性、凝胶耗材寿命、量测溯源和数据导出比仅看像素数更重要。
applications.en: Use cases span manufacturing quality, aerospace maintenance, automotive and robotics R&D. Access, gel lifetime, metrological traceability and export formats matter beyond pixel count.

integration.zh: 六维传感器用于机器人接触力控制与测试，称重和单轴产品面向测量设备及工业检测，风洞天平和平台面向专用试验。采集模块承担激励、信号调理及通信输出，因此部分供电、采样和接口参数属于模块而非裸传感器。
integration.en: Six-axis sensors serve robotic contact control and testing; load cells address industrial measurement, while wind-tunnel balances and platforms serve specialized experiments. Acquisition modules provide excitation, conditioning and communications, so some electrical specifications belong to the electronics rather than the bare transducer.

verification.zh: 判断：目录宽度有助于覆盖不同尺寸和量程，但产品数量不能直接代表交付规模。官网产能、融资及客户合作信息应与收入、订单和实际出货分开阅读。
verification.en: Assessment: catalog breadth supports different sizes and ranges, but model count is not delivery volume. Published capacity, financing and partnerships should be distinguished from revenue, orders and shipments.

overview.zh: KWH00C100LEC 是测量链路接口组件。公开规格包括外形尺寸(mm): 100×50×30 mm；供电电压(VDC): 9~24 V；材质: 铝合金；表面处理: 阳极化。
overview.en: KWH00C100LEC is an acquisition-interface component. Published specifications include 外形Dimensions(mm): 100×50×30 mm; Supply voltage(VDC): 9~24 V; Material: 铝合金; Surface treatment: 阳极化.

overview.zh: 连接传感器模拟信号与上位控制系统。应分别确认输入信号、桥路激励、通道数量、输出接口和隔离要求；模块自身不等同于力传感器。
overview.en: Connects sensor signals with host control systems. Confirm signal inputs, bridge excitation, channel count, output interfaces and isolation separately; the electronics are not themselves a force transducer.

applications.zh: 公开场景涉及机器人本体、系统集成、计量测试与科研机构。选择时需核对轴向量程、联合载荷、安装刚度、温漂和标定矩阵。
applications.en: Public applications include robot OEMs, integrators, metrology and research. Selection requires checking per-axis ranges, combined loading, mounting stiffness, thermal drift and calibration matrices.

integration.zh: 六维传感器用于机器人接触力控制与测试，称重和单轴产品面向测量设备及工业检测，风洞天平和平台面向专用试验。采集模块承担激励、信号调理及通信输出，因此部分供电、采样和接口参数属于模块而非裸传感器。
integration.en: Six-axis sensors serve robotic contact control and testing; load cells address industrial measurement, while wind-tunnel balances and platforms serve specialized experiments. Acquisition modules provide excitation, conditioning and communications, so some electrical specifications belong to the electronics rather than the bare transducer.

overview.zh: KWH06C100HLA 是测量链路接口组件。公开规格包括供电电压(VDC): 9~24 V；通信方式: RS422；长×宽×高(mm): 112×105×32 mm；工作温度(℃): -20~65 ℃。
overview.en: KWH06C100HLA is an acquisition-interface component. Published specifications include Supply voltage(VDC): 9~24 V; Communication interface: RS422; Length x width x height(mm): 112×105×32 mm; Operating temperature(℃): -20~65 ℃.

overview.zh: 连接传感器模拟信号与上位控制系统。应分别确认输入信号、桥路激励、通道数量、输出接口和隔离要求；模块自身不等同于力传感器。
overview.en: Connects sensor signals with host control systems. Confirm signal inputs, bridge excitation, channel count, output interfaces and isolation separately; the electronics are not themselves a force transducer.

applications.zh: 公开场景涉及机器人本体、系统集成、计量测试与科研机构。选择时需核对轴向量程、联合载荷、安装刚度、温漂和标定矩阵。
applications.en: Public applications include robot OEMs, integrators, metrology and research. Selection requires checking per-axis ranges, combined loading, mounting stiffness, thermal drift and calibration matrices.

integration.zh: 六维传感器用于机器人接触力控制与测试，称重和单轴产品面向测量设备及工业检测，风洞天平和平台面向专用试验。采集模块承担激励、信号调理及通信输出，因此部分供电、采样和接口参数属于模块而非裸传感器。
integration.en: Six-axis sensors serve robotic contact control and testing; load cells address industrial measurement, while wind-tunnel balances and platforms serve specialized experiments. Acquisition modules provide excitation, conditioning and communications, so some electrical specifications belong to the electronics rather than the bare transducer.

overview.zh: KWH06C100HLC 是测量链路接口组件。公开规格包括供电电压(VDC): 9~24 V；通信方式: CAN；长×宽×高(mm): 112×105×32 mm；工作温度(℃): -20~65 ℃。
overview.en: KWH06C100HLC is an acquisition-interface component. Published specifications include Supply voltage(VDC): 9~24 V; Communication interface: CAN; Length x width x height(mm): 112×105×32 mm; Operating temperature(℃): -20~65 ℃.

overview.zh: 连接传感器模拟信号与上位控制系统。应分别确认输入信号、桥路激励、通道数量、输出接口和隔离要求；模块自身不等同于力传感器。
overview.en: Connects sensor signals with host control systems. Confirm signal inputs, bridge excitation, channel count, output interfaces and isolation separately; the electronics are not themselves a force transducer.

applications.zh: 公开场景涉及机器人本体、系统集成、计量测试与科研机构。选择时需核对轴向量程、联合载荷、安装刚度、温漂和标定矩阵。
applications.en: Public applications include robot OEMs, integrators, metrology and research. Selection requires checking per-axis ranges, combined loading, mounting stiffness, thermal drift and calibration matrices.

integration.zh: 六维传感器用于机器人接触力控制与测试，称重和单轴产品面向测量设备及工业检测，风洞天平和平台面向专用试验。采集模块承担激励、信号调理及通信输出，因此部分供电、采样和接口参数属于模块而非裸传感器。
integration.en: Six-axis sensors serve robotic contact control and testing; load cells address industrial measurement, while wind-tunnel balances and platforms serve specialized experiments. Acquisition modules provide excitation, conditioning and communications, so some electrical specifications belong to the electronics rather than the bare transducer.

verification.en: Assessment: catalog breadth supports different sizes and ranges, but model count is not delivery volume. Published capacity, financing and partnerships should be distinguished from revenue, orders and shipments.

overview.zh: KWH06C106NEN 是测量链路接口组件。公开规格包括外形尺寸(mm): 106×65×30 mm；供电电压(VDC): 9~24 V；材质: 铝合金；表面处理: 阳极化。
overview.en: KWH06C106NEN is an acquisition-interface component. Published specifications include 外形Dimensions(mm): 106×65×30 mm; Supply voltage(VDC): 9~24 V; Material: 铝合金; Surface treatment: 阳极化.

overview.zh: 连接传感器模拟信号与上位控制系统。应分别确认输入信号、桥路激励、通道数量、输出接口和隔离要求；模块自身不等同于力传感器。
overview.en: Connects sensor signals with host control systems. Confirm signal inputs, bridge excitation, channel count, output interfaces and isolation separately; the electronics are not themselves a force transducer.

applications.zh: 公开场景涉及机器人本体、系统集成、计量测试与科研机构。选择时需核对轴向量程、联合载荷、安装刚度、温漂和标定矩阵。
applications.en: Public applications include robot OEMs, integrators, metrology and research. Selection requires checking per-axis ranges, combined loading, mounting stiffness, thermal drift and calibration matrices.

integration.zh: 除灵巧手外，公司官网列有 AMR、AMMR 和 ACS 控制系统。手部型号在驱动比、关节扭矩、通信频率和触觉配置上存在差异，V6F 另有独立系统环境要求。
integration.en: The company also lists AMR, AMMR and ACS control systems. Hand models differ in gearing, joint torque, communication rate and tactile configuration; V6F has its own host-system requirements.

verification.zh: 判断：代际丰富有利于按研究目标选择，但历史算法和机械附件不一定跨代兼容。官方载荷带测试方法限定，应在相同抓取工况下比较。
verification.en: Assessment: multiple generations offer choice, but algorithms and attachments are not necessarily cross-compatible. Published payload depends on the test method and needs like-for-like grasp conditions.

overview.zh: Allegro Hand V5 Sense 是多指电驱灵巧手。公开规格包括自由度: 4 Fingers × 4 = 16 (Active)；驱动 / 堵转扭矩: 0.92 Nm / 1.84 Nm (2nd joint of the finger excluding the thumb)；驱动 / 额定扭矩: 0.23 Nm / 0.46 Nm (2nd joint of the finger excluding the thumb)；关节分辨率: 0.088 deg。
overview.en: Allegro Hand V5 Sense is an electrically driven dexterous hand. Published specifications include Degrees of Freedom: 4 Fingers × 4 = 16 (Active); Actuation / Stall Torque: 0.92 Nm / 1.84 Nm (2nd joint of the finger excluding the thumb); Actuation / Nominal Torque: 0.23 Nm / 0.46 Nm (2nd joint of the finger excluding the thumb); Joint Resolution: 0.088 deg.

overview.zh: 用于机器人末端抓取、操作学习及遥操作集成。自由度、指尖力与整手负载分别描述不同能力，触觉版和标准版不能混用规格。
overview.en: Intended for robotic grasping, manipulation learning and teleoperation integration. Degrees of freedom, fingertip force and whole-hand payload describe different capabilities; tactile and standard editions have separate specifications.

overview.zh: V5 Sense 产品页补充 16 通道电容式气压感测、前侧指尖感测结构及增益调节工具。新版温度补偿会改变传感读数，不能假定旧标定可直接复用。
overview.en: The V5 Sense page adds 16-channel capacitive air-pressure sensing, front-side fingertip sensing and gain-tuning tools. New-model temperature compensation changes readings, so earlier calibration is not assumed reusable.

applications.zh: 面向机器人开发、抓取研究以及移动操作集成。需要区分手部主动自由度、压力传感器和腕部载荷测量，并核对 ROS 版本和通信适配。
applications.en: Targets robotics development, grasp research and mobile manipulation. Active hand DoF, pressure sensing and wrist load measurement should be distinguished, along with ROS and interface compatibility.

integration.zh: 除灵巧手外，公司官网列有 AMR、AMMR 和 ACS 控制系统。手部型号在驱动比、关节扭矩、通信频率和触觉配置上存在差异，V6F 另有独立系统环境要求。
integration.en: The company also lists AMR, AMMR and ACS control systems. Hand models differ in gearing, joint torque, communication rate and tactile configuration; V6F has its own host-system requirements.

verification.zh: 判断：代际丰富有利于按研究目标选择，但历史算法和机械附件不一定跨代兼容。官方载荷带测试方法限定，应在相同抓取工况下比较。
verification.en: Assessment: multiple generations offer choice, but algorithms and attachments are not necessarily cross-compatible. Published payload depends on the test method and needs like-for-like grasp conditions.

overview.zh: Allegro Hand V6F 是多指电驱灵巧手。公开规格包括自由度: 5 Fingers × 4 = 20 (Active)；驱动 / 堵转扭矩: 0.92 Nm；驱动 / 额定扭矩: 0.23 Nm；关节分辨率: 0.088 deg。
overview.en: Allegro Hand V6F is an electrically driven dexterous hand. Published specifications include Degrees of Freedom: 5 Fingers × 4 = 20 (Active); Actuation / Stall Torque: 0.92 Nm; Actuation / Nominal Torque: 0.23 Nm; Joint Resolution: 0.088 deg.

overview.zh: 用于机器人末端抓取、操作学习及遥操作集成。自由度、指尖力与整手负载分别描述不同能力，触觉版和标准版不能混用规格。
overview.en: Intended for robotic grasping, manipulation learning and teleoperation integration. Degrees of freedom, fingertip force and whole-hand payload describe different capabilities; tactile and standard editions have separate specifications.

overview.zh: 当前 V6 F 页面描述指尖、关节和掌部压力感知，以及电流、位置、刚度控制和监测工具。页面质量与压力规格已不同于旧缓存；两组值并列保留，版本号未明确。
overview.en: The current V6 F page describes fingertip, joint and palm pressure sensing, current/position/stiffness control and monitoring tools. Mass and pressure specifications differ from the earlier cache; both are retained without an established revision identifier.

applications.zh: 面向机器人开发、抓取研究以及移动操作集成。需要区分手部主动自由度、压力传感器和腕部载荷测量，并核对 ROS 版本和通信适配。
applications.en: Targets robotics development, grasp research and mobile manipulation. Active hand DoF, pressure sensing and wrist load measurement should be distinguished, along with ROS and interface compatibility.

integration.zh: 除灵巧手外，公司官网列有 AMR、AMMR 和 ACS 控制系统。手部型号在驱动比、关节扭矩、通信频率和触觉配置上存在差异，V6F 另有独立系统环境要求。
integration.en: The company also lists AMR, AMMR and ACS control systems. Hand models differ in gearing, joint torque, communication rate and tactile configuration; V6F has its own host-system requirements.

verification.zh: 判断：代际丰富有利于按研究目标选择，但历史算法和机械附件不一定跨代兼容。官方载荷带测试方法限定，应在相同抓取工况下比较。
verification.en: Assessment: multiple generations offer choice, but algorithms and attachments are not necessarily cross-compatible. Published payload depends on the test method and needs like-for-like grasp conditions.

overview.zh: Allegro Hand V5 Plus 是多指电驱灵巧手。公开规格包括自由度: 4 Fingers × 4 = 16 (Active)；驱动 / 堵转扭矩: 0.92 Nm / 1.84 Nm (2nd joint of the finger excluding the thumb)；驱动 / 额定扭矩: 0.23 Nm / 0.46 Nm (2nd joint of the finger excluding the thumb)；关节分辨率: 0.088 deg。
overview.en: Allegro Hand V5 Plus is an electrically driven dexterous hand. Published specifications include Degrees of Freedom: 4 Fingers × 4 = 16 (Active); Actuation / Stall Torque: 0.92 Nm / 1.84 Nm (2nd joint of the finger excluding the thumb); Actuation / Nominal Torque: 0.23 Nm / 0.46 Nm (2nd joint of the finger excluding the thumb); Joint Resolution: 0.088 deg.

overview.zh: 用于机器人末端抓取、操作学习及遥操作集成。自由度、指尖力与整手负载分别描述不同能力，触觉版和标准版不能混用规格。
overview.en: Intended for robotic grasping, manipulation learning and teleoperation integration. Degrees of freedom, fingertip force and whole-hand payload describe different capabilities; tactile and standard editions have separate specifications.

applications.zh: 面向机器人开发、抓取研究以及移动操作集成。需要区分手部主动自由度、压力传感器和腕部载荷测量，并核对 ROS 版本和通信适配。
applications.en: Targets robotics development, grasp research and mobile manipulation. Active hand DoF, pressure sensing and wrist load measurement should be distinguished, along with ROS and interface compatibility.

type.zh: 五指视觉触觉电驱灵巧手
type.en: Five-finger electrically driven vision-tactile dexterous hand

integration.zh: 指尖视觉触觉通过独立 USB 2.0 链路；关节控制采用 RS-485/Ethernet 和 Modbus 等协议。主机系统要求与本体、掌部压力传感规格分别核对。
integration.en: Fingertip vision tactile data uses a separate USB 2.0 link; joint control uses RS-485/Ethernet and protocols including Modbus. Host requirements, hand specifications and palm-pressure specifications must be checked separately.

verification.zh: 最大 15 kg 为缺少测试条件的网页声明；图像模式、掌部温度范围和主机配置均不转作整手额定值。
verification.en: The maximum 15 kg webpage claim lacks test conditions; image modes, palm temperature range and host configuration are not whole-hand ratings.

overview.zh: Allegro Hand V6 V 为五指、20 主动自由度灵巧手，指尖采用视觉触觉，掌部使用压力传感器。产品页给出 1,150 g 质量、0.088 deg 关节分辨率，以及电流、位置、刚度控制能力。
overview.en: Allegro Hand V6 V is a five-finger, 20-active-DoF hand with vision-based fingertip tactile sensing and palm pressure sensing. The product page lists a mass of 1,150 g, joint resolution of 0.088 deg, and current, position and stiffness control.

overview.zh: 指尖输出彩色接触图像，VGA 与 QVGA 对应不同帧率；传感链路独立于本体控制网络。未从 V6 F 继承力传感、协议地址或机械尺寸。
overview.en: Fingertips output color contact images with distinct VGA/QVGA frame-rate modes over a link separate from the hand-control network. Force sensing, protocol addresses and mechanical dimensions are not inherited from V6 F.

applications.zh: 机器人抓取与接触几何研究；集成时分别验证控制网络、视觉数据链路、安装空间和热条件。
applications.en: Robotic grasping and contact-geometry research; integration requires separate checks of control networking, visual data links, mounting space and thermal conditions.

integration.en: Integrates with supported industrial or collaborative robots through OnRobot's common mechanical, electrical, and software interface; flange, controller, Compute Box, changer, cabling, and software plug-in depend on the robot model.

verification.zh: 根据表面孔隙、吸盘布局、泄漏、工件重心和加速度验证额定/最大负载，不将最大值当作任意工况额定值。
verification.en: Validate rated versus maximum payload against porosity, cup layout, leakage, center of gravity, and acceleration; do not treat the maximum as universal rated capacity.

overview.zh: VG10 是 OnRobot 当前公开目录中的独立产品或变体，参数表按该型号保存，不向同系列其他型号扩展。
overview.en: VG10 is a distinct current OnRobot catalog product or variant. Its specification table is stored at model level and is not extended to adjacent models.

overview.zh: VG10 具备两路独立真空和四个手动可调吸盘臂，公开额定负载 10 kg、最大负载 15 kg。
overview.en: VG10 provides two independent vacuum channels and four manually adjustable suction arms, with 10 kg rated and 15 kg maximum published payload.

applications.zh: 板材、箱体、拾放和机床上下料
applications.en: Sheet, box, pick-and-place, and machine-tending handling

type.en: 25 kg form-fit heavy-duty three-finger electric gripper

integration.zh: 通过 OnRobot 统一机械、电气与软件接口接入适配的工业或协作机器人；具体法兰、控制器、Compute Box、快换、线缆和软件插件按机器人型号配置。
integration.en: Integrates with supported industrial or collaborative robots through OnRobot's common mechanical, electrical, and software interface; flange, controller, Compute Box, changer, cabling, and software plug-in depend on the robot model.

verification.zh: 核对夹持模式、滚花指尖留痕风险、工件居中、指端允许扭矩、制动和机器人负载。
verification.en: Verify grip mode, marking risk from knurled tips, workpiece centering, permissible fingertip torque, brake, and robot payload.

overview.zh: 3FG25 是 OnRobot 当前公开目录中的独立产品或变体，参数表按该型号保存，不向同系列其他型号扩展。
overview.en: 3FG25 is a distinct current OnRobot catalog product or variant. Its specification table is stored at model level and is not extended to adjacent models.

overview.zh: 3FG25 面向更重零件，公开 50–450 N 普通夹力、18–155 mm 外夹与 41–184 mm 内撑范围，并提供制动断电保持。
overview.en: 3FG25 targets heavier parts with 50–450 N normal force, 18–155 mm external and 41–184 mm internal ranges, plus brake-based power-loss holding.

applications.zh: 重型 CNC 上下料、油性圆柱件搬运和装配
applications.en: Heavy CNC tending, oily cylindrical-part handling, and assembly

verification.zh: 核对 3–7 bar 气源、空气品质与耗气、纸箱刚度、20 个吸盘布局、噪声和实际节拍。
verification.en: Verify 3–7 bar air supply, air quality and consumption, box stiffness, 20-cup layout, noise, and actual cycle time.

overview.zh: VGP30 是 OnRobot 当前公开目录中的独立产品或变体，参数表按该型号保存，不向同系列其他型号扩展。
overview.en: VGP30 is a distinct current OnRobot catalog product or variant. Its specification table is stored at model level and is not extended to adjacent models.

overview.zh: VGP30 使用压缩空气，公开纸箱负载 30 kg、总流量最高 440 L/min，并分成两路独立真空通道。
overview.en: VGP30 uses compressed air, publishes 30 kg cardboard payload and up to 440 L/min total airflow, and provides two independent vacuum channels.

overview.zh: v1.5 数据表补充了不同真空目标的供气要求、止回阀吸盘的密封与固件条件，以及加强支架、随货紧固件和机械图尺寸。附件配置和尺寸图差异分别保留，不据此推导整机总力矩、总质量或新的额定载荷。
overview.en: The v1.5 datasheet adds air-supply requirements for different vacuum targets, sealing and firmware conditions for check-valve cups, plus the reinforcement bracket, delivered fasteners and mechanical drawing dimensions. Accessory configurations and drawing discrepancies remain separate; no total torque, assembly mass or new rated payload is derived.

applications.zh: 高负载箱体码垛与混线物料搬运
applications.en: High-payload box palletizing and high-mix material handling

type.zh: 带轴向顺应与扭矩控制的自动锁付工具
type.en: Automated screwdriving tool with axial compliance and torque control

integration.zh: 通过 OnRobot 工具接口连接机器人，可结合螺钉供料器和不同批头/延长杆处理公制及英制紧固件。
integration.en: Connects through the OnRobot tool interface and can combine with a screw feeder and different bits or extensions for metric and imperial fasteners.

verification.zh: 按螺钉规格、材料、目标扭矩、自攻条件、轴向预压、批头、供料方式、位置误差和节拍做工艺验证。
verification.en: Validate process by screw size, material, target torque, self-tapping condition, axial preload, bit, feeding method, positional error, and cycle time.

overview.zh: OnRobot Screwdriver 的公开扭矩范围为 0.15–5 N·m，低扭矩和高扭矩区间采用不同精度定义，并公开 55 mm 轴向行程和三档预压力。
overview.en: OnRobot Screwdriver publishes a 0.15–5 N·m range with different accuracy definitions below and above 1.33 N·m, plus 55 mm axial travel and three preload settings.

overview.zh: 螺钉尺寸覆盖不等于任意螺钉都可稳定锁付；螺纹成形、自攻材料、供料、批头啮合和目标质量标准仍需实物工艺试验。
overview.en: Nominal screw-size coverage does not guarantee every fastener process; thread forming, substrate, feeding, bit engagement, and quality criteria still require physical process trials.

overview.zh: v1.7 数据表的公制、美制及铝/塑料自攻螺钉选配表按具体行列保留批头、承载件、固定件和夹持器组合，并补充延长件、安装方向、示例边界和机械图标注。选配代码不是新增产品型号；示例夹持器、标准名称和图纸尺寸口径的差异均单独注明，不推定为通用适配或无条件额定值。
overview.en: The v1.7 metric, US and aluminum/plastic self-tapping selection tables retain row-specific bit, carrier, fix and holder combinations, supplemented by extenders, operating orientation, example boundaries and mechanical-drawing callouts. Selection codes are not new product models; example-holder, standard-label and dimension-scope discrepancies remain explicit rather than becoming universal compatibility or unconditional ratings.

applications.zh: 装配线锁付、机电产品组装和多规格螺钉换产
applications.en: Assembly-line fastening, electromechanical assembly, and multi-size screw changeover

overview.zh: VGP20 是 OnRobot 当前公开目录中的独立产品或变体，参数表按该型号保存，不向同系列其他型号扩展。
overview.en: VGP20 is a distinct current OnRobot catalog product or variant. Its specification table is stored at model level and is not extended to adjacent models.

overview.zh: VGP20 提供四路独立真空、最高 48 L/min 总流量；20 kg 是满足低加速度等条件的最大值，典型纸箱负载为 10 kg。
overview.en: VGP20 provides four independent channels and up to 48 L/min total airflow. The 20 kg figure is conditional on low acceleration and other constraints, while typical cardboard payload is 10 kg.

overview.zh: v1.7 数据表补充高载荷支架、外部真空气路与控制器输出边界，以及按表面和吸盘数量区分的薄膜附件载荷表。选型、真空参考、噪声测试和机械图分别保留适用条件；接线示例、第三方阀件建议、未证实的旧存储温度与可疑英寸标注均不提升为无条件额定值。
overview.en: The v1.7 datasheet adds the high-payload bracket, external-vacuum circuits and controller-output limits, plus foil-accessory load tables by surface and cup count. Selection guidance, vacuum references, noise tests and mechanical drawings retain their conditions; example circuits, third-party valve recommendations, unverified legacy storage temperature and suspect inch callouts do not become unconditional ratings.

overview.zh: 2FGP20 是 OnRobot 当前公开目录中的独立产品或变体，参数表按该型号保存，不向同系列其他型号扩展。
overview.en: 2FGP20 is a distinct current OnRobot catalog product or variant. Its specification table is stored at model level and is not extended to adjacent models.

overview.zh: 2FGP20 以 260 mm 行程处理箱体，并可组合真空模块与 KLT 手指；不同手指、真空模块和加强支架会改变质量与允许扭矩。
overview.en: 2FGP20 uses 260 mm stroke for boxes and can combine a vacuum module and KLT fingers; finger set, vacuum module, and reinforcement bracket change mass and permissible torque.

overview.zh: v1.9 硬件资料补充六种软垫位置的最大力、KLT 附件与自定义接口、手指基座力矩、真空布局、装箱清单及两种装配尺寸图。原有通用规格完整继承；新增图示、单位、条件和示例分别注明页码，不作为无条件评级或整机总转矩。
overview.en: The v1.9 hardware source adds force limits for six pad positions, KLT accessories and custom interfaces, finger-base moment, vacuum layouts, box contents and drawings for two assemblies. Legacy general specifications are carried intact; added drawings, units, conditions and examples retain page locators and do not become unconditional ratings or a whole-tool total moment.

applications.zh: 箱体码垛、滑托板搬运和 KLT 周转箱处理
applications.en: Box palletizing, slip-sheet handling, and KLT tote handling

type.zh: 100 kg 负载机器人第七轴升降机

integration.zh: 作为机器人底座的垂直第七轴，与机器人、码垛软件、Pallet Station 和末端工具组成高位码垛或多高度工作站。
integration.en: Acts as a vertical seventh axis under the robot and combines with the robot, palletizing software, Pallet Station, and end tooling for high-stack or multi-height cells.

verification.zh: 按机器人与工具总质量、静/动态倾覆矩、行程、速度、占空比、地基、护栏和安全控制验证。
verification.en: Validate total robot/tool mass, static and dynamic overturning moment, travel, speed, duty, foundation, guarding, and safety control.

overview.zh: LIFT100 提供 900 mm 行程和 0–100 kg 负载范围，数据表同时限制静态与动态扭矩以及高速连续运行占空比。
overview.en: LIFT100 provides 900 mm travel and a 0–100 kg payload range, with separate static/dynamic torque and high-speed duty limits.

overview.zh: 100 kg 不是任意偏心和速度下的通用能力；工作站设计必须把机器人、工具、工件、重心和加速度转换为升降轴载荷与地基条件。
overview.en: The 100 kg figure is not universal across offset and speed; cell design must translate robot, tool, workpiece, center of gravity, and acceleration into lift and foundation loads.

overview.zh: v1.4 资料补充拖链接口、装箱件和 v1/v2 底座图纸，版本孔径分别保留。计算寿命的列定义与使用假设已修正，定位典型值、噪声试验、速度单位差异以及占空比图文差异保持明确边界，不作为通用保证或新的型号身份。
overview.en: The v1.4 source adds the energy-chain interface, box contents and v1/v2 base drawings with separate hole diameters. Calculated-life column meanings and use assumptions are corrected; typical positioning, noise tests, speed-unit discrepancy and duty text/graph discrepancy remain bounded rather than universal guarantees or new model identities.

applications.zh: 高位码垛、多高度机床上下料和扩展垂直工作空间
applications.en: High-stack palletizing, multi-height machine tending, and expanded vertical workspace

wonik-robotics.zh: Allegro 品牌介绍将其起点描述为机器人仿真软件，随后在 2012 年推出 1.0 版灵巧手；页面强调持续升级和面向不同研究任务的扩展。其关于科技企业与研究机构采用的陈述属于厂商说明，未提供可核验的客户订单或收入明细。
wonik-robotics.en: The Allegro brand describes an origin in robot simulation software followed by its version 1.0 hand in 2012, with continued upgrades for varied research tasks. Its statements about adoption by technology companies and research institutions are manufacturer claims, not disclosed customer orders or revenue records.

shadow-robot.zh: Shadow 的公司历史与早期爱好者项目需要分开理解。Richard Greenhill 在 2018 年回顾中记述，1987 年 11 月召集了 12 人再次开展机器人项目；团队早期研究双足机构与气动肌肉，后来转向机器人手。公司为承接客户订单于 1997 年正式注册，2022 年品牌回顾再次确认该年份。1987 年是团队活动起点，不是法人注册年；早期订单也不是融资轮。
shadow-robot.en: Shadow distinguishes its hobbyist origins from company registration. In a 2018 retrospective, Richard Greenhill recalled assembling 12 participants in November 1987 for a renewed robotics project. Early work covered biped mechanisms and pneumatic muscles before the focus moved to hands. Registration followed a customer order in 1997, also confirmed in the 2022 brand retrospective. The 1987 project start is not incorporation, and an early order is not a funding round.

shadow-robot.zh: 这条技术路线有明确的历史节点：公司在后来的回顾中记述，2002 年携双足机器人和气动肌肉驱动的手臂原型参加横滨 Robodex；公司史列示 2019 年获得英国女王企业创新奖。2024 年 5 月 10 日，公司介绍与 Google DeepMind 多年合作的 DEX-EE，并预告将在 ICRA 展示该手，强调模块化、可维修性和面向机器学习的控制访问。该文是展前公告，不据此确认当天已经完成展出，也不将合作、奖项或演示转换为销量、融资或收入。
shadow-robot.en: A later company retrospective describes a biped and pneumatic-muscle hand/arm prototype at Robodex in Yokohama in 2002; its history lists a 2019 Queen's Award for Enterprise in Innovation. On May 10, 2024, Shadow described DEX-EE as the result of years of collaboration with Google DeepMind and announced plans to show it at ICRA, emphasizing modular repair and control access for machine learning. That pre-event announcement does not confirm exhibition completion on its publication date; collaboration, awards and demonstrations are not sales, funding or revenue.

xela-robotics.zh: XELA 的创始团队把触觉研究延伸到系统开发：Tito Pradhono Tomo 在早稻田大学博士项目中开发 uSkin；Sophon Somlor 自 2012 年研究电容式三轴触觉，并积累硬件、模具、电子与微控制器开发经验。公司人物简介记述 Shuji Hashimoto 于 2019 年 4 月以 CEO 身份加入，Valentino Fagard 于 2024 年 12 月加入领导层；所用人物简介页面标题分别列为 Director 和 COO。历史加入日期和页面标题不确定现任职务或任期，未披露的转任日期、股权或融资不作推断。
xela-robotics.en: XELA's founding team connects tactile research with system development: Tito Pradhono Tomo developed uSkin during doctoral work at Waseda, while Sophon Somlor began capacitive three-axis tactile research in 2012 and developed hardware, molding, electronics and microcontroller expertise. Company biographies date Shuji Hashimoto's arrival as CEO to April 2019 and Valentino Fagard's entry into leadership to December 2024; the biography page headings used here list Director and COO respectively. Historical joining dates and page headings do not establish present roles, tenures, undisclosed transition dates, equity or financing.

conditions.zh: 修正旧记录的“或”关系：原表是两行、不同列，不是二选一或先到为准。仅典型码垛应用、每天两班、每周五天；计算结果不等于保证寿命或保修期。来源 SHA-256: e8b10394da980392f548dafcc97c05e3c35d24a901a739b6b278f5c96f557af6。
conditions.en: Corrects the legacy "or" relationship: two source rows in different columns, not alternatives or whichever comes first. Typical palletizing, two shifts per day and five days per week only; calculations are not guaranteed life or warranty. Source SHA-256: e8b10394da980392f548dafcc97c05e3c35d24a901a739b6b278f5c96f557af6.

corrections.reason: The source states separate calculated operation life Minimum1000000cycles and calculated lifetime Typical10years. It does not state or/whichever comes first.

conditions.en: 100% below 70 mm/s; 90% above 70 mm/s, with a 70 s pause after 10 min continuous operation.

locator.zh: PDF/印刷第 2-3 页；Duty cycle 行、星号脚注、Duty Cycle 文字及图
locator.en: PDF/printed pages 2-3; Duty cycle rows, starred footnote, Duty Cycle text and graph

conditions.zh: 低于 70 mm/s 为 100%，高于 70 mm/s 的文字为 90%，连续运行最多 10 min 后暂停 70 s；表中两者均列在 Minimum，并附典型码垛、每天两班、每周五天条件。同页曲线由 70 mm/s、100% 下降至 100 mm/s、90%，与文字区间不完全一致；文字未定义恰为 70 mm/s 的情况。不插值、不自选一种解释为无条件额定值，需厂家澄清。来源 SHA-256: e8b10394da980392f548dafcc97c05e3c35d24a901a739b6b278f5c96f557af6。
conditions.en: Below 70 mm/s:100%; above 70 mm/s:text states90%, at most10min continuous operation followed by70s pause. Both table figures appear in Minimum with typical palletizing, two shifts/day, five days/week. The same-page graph slopes from70mm/s at100% to100mm/s at90%, not fully matching the text interval; text does not define exactly70mm/s. No interpolation or selection of one interpretation as an unconditional rating; manufacturer clarification required. Source SHA-256: e8b10394da980392f548dafcc97c05e3c35d24a901a739b6b278f5c96f557af6.

corrections.reason: Existing timing retained; add maximum continuous duration, table columns/use assumptions and explicit table/text-versus-graph discrepancy without inventing an exactly70mm/s rule.
